item.title: Trump Admin And States Must Pick ‘Reality’ Over ‘Bad Science’ In Nuclear Energy Partnership, Analysts Say
item.description: The Department of Energy's (DOE) recently announced plan to work with state governments on nuclear research can open the door to a promising new energy landscape if policymakers take a "reality"-centered approach, analysts told the Daily Caller News Foundation.

item.title: AARON MASAITIS: Donald Trump Is The President Europe Needs
item.description: After nearly 20 years of service in the United States Marine Corps, I've learned one enduring truth: peace is achieved through strength. America’s strength, courage, and leadership have guided the world for decades. In Europe, American strength was responsible for the destruction of tyranny during two world wars, paving the way for the peace and prosperity that followed.

item.title: KELLY HANCOCK: Texas Taking Stand Against Foreign Terrorist Schools
item.description: National School Choice Week celebrates the power of empowering parents. Texas is leading this movement at an unprecedented scale, launching the largest first-year school choice program in American history. But as we approve providers to receive tax-funded Texas Education Freedom Accounts, we’re drawing a clear line: schools with ties to terrorist organizations or foreign adversaries will not be permitted to participate.
